notes.title: Stories Are Live in Passion Rift!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44758768/0dbfc53f84fa01fa1bcd66124ab151e02c54079f.png[/img]

Your favorite Stars now have their own mini-arcs. Play through a short chain of tasks, grab rewards along the way, and unlock a special date + scene at the end. Simple, guided, and super satisfying.

🙋‍♂️ How It Works?
• Short & sweet: Each Story is a focused set of tasks you can clear at your own pace.
• Steady rewards: Every task gives a little something; finishing the Story unlocks the big finale.
• Play as you like: Tasks match what you already do (Adventures, merges, spending Energy, opening chests). Just keep playing and check off objectives.
• More time with your faves: Dialogues and a scene that spotlight the Star you’re following.

🎁 What You Get?
• On the way: Currency, items, and other handy goodies for each task you finish.
• The finale: A short date that leads into a scene: your reward for completing the Story.

So dive in, chase the rewards, and unlock the scenes!
Don’t let your favorite Star’s story pass you by! See you in game!

With intent, JNT Corp. Reality Division
Watching. Waiting. Always filming. 🎥

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3578240/Passion_Rift/]Passion Rift on Steam![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33831998/23bc1eba49dddaae25c37d8841c87a95d97a2366.png[/img]

Hello, everyone! We are getting ready to release our new adult entertainment production:

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1905950/Shelter_69/]Shelter 69[/url][/h1]

In the [b]distant future of 2153[/b], after the world population collapsed because of dwindling male births due to an unexplained shrinkage of the Y chromosome, the world seems doomed and the situation is bleak. With males being so few and far between, they are kept as prisoners, enslaved into a life of misery and dehumanized treatment...

[i]...until you come along.[/i]

Released after thirteen years of solitude from an underground bunker where your mother locked you in to keep you safe from the deteriorating outside world, you are now 21 and ready to make your first steps outside. A fortunate meeting provides you with a chance to make things right and [b]lead your own settlement of beautiful women[/b] to recover society and bring stability back to an insane world... with all the [b]sexy companionship you ever could have desired...~[/b]

notes.title: 1.65.0 - Opposites Attract
notes.content:
[i]With Season's Weddings concluded, it's time for Cleo to shine. This event was postponed back in September due to some unexpected technical problems that we managed to finally fix. Now that the original update plan has been completed, we present to you the last event: Opposities Attract.[/i]

Your daughter is righteous and kind, and Klara is proud - even though she's ready to let her fists do the talking! Sounds just like Cleo - and, indeed, she is locked into a terrifying conundrum that fisticuffs can't solve! Luckily, you're there to give the wind she needs under her wings! A new epilogue with our [b]NEW EVENT: Opposites Attract[/b]! With our [b]SPECIAL OFFER, we have for you a UNIQUE, LEGENDARY Cherry Top[/b]! Two new artworks by Alexander Souto to unlock for you, with new clothes to get!

- NEW EVENT: The Pressure must be released!
- SPECIAL OFFER: UNIQUE, LEGENDARY Cherry Top!
- NEW PICTURES: Cleo and Annabelle!
- New clothes to unlock!

No stress is too big for Cleo, but you need to be there, too! This is an important occasion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33831998/3247c863e9d11971a0ecf16c2fe61761e126b16e.png[/img]

notes.title: 1.70.0 - Fate Uncertain
notes.content:
Annabelle's dreams came true - every single one of them, and it's thanks to you! Well, it seems everyone is accounted for... but didn't we forget someone important? Hold your horses for now with that, though, for we have a huge three weeks ahead of us!

First week, we have for you a long-awaited update - level 8 - Sweetheart added to Klara and Angela! Read their heartfelt emails sent just before the events of End Times! Together with that, we will have a Relicstravaganza - Relic drop quantities increased by 50% more, and with that, a Special Offer: Glimpse Into Past! Unlock loads of past content by purchasing 7500 Relics!

Second week, it will be time to glimpse into the story of someone whom we have neglected a little... even though we owe her a lot! For that reason we have a [b]NEW EVENT: Fate Uncertain[/b]! As our final farewell to Pocket Waifu, we have this final [b]SPECIAL OFFER: a UNIQUE, LEGENDARY Short Wedding Dress[/b]! Two new pictures drawn by Alex specifically for this final event, and some very special wedding-themed clothes to unlock!

- NEW EVENT: Eternity is a long time!
- SPECIAL OFFER: UNIQUE, LEGENDARY Short Wedding Dress!
- NEW PICTURES by Alexander Souto, featuring Andrea and Angela!
- New wedding-themed clothes to unlock!

For the Third, and final, week of updates, we will have a special Catch-Up Offer for you: relic clothes bought in packs will cost up to 50% less - details in the Relic Store! We will add the previous stock of event rewards into the Relic Store, changing the time for new stuff to get added to a three-week period. To kickstart these changes, Relic prices for Girls are lowered by 33%, while Scenes and Stories are lower by 30%! One more thing: we will have for you a bit of a sneak peek at our next project, so be ready!
Love is eternal. Eternity is endless. Even in the face of Armageddon, there is hope. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33831998/97530bd692d470d75fd9d0a9258f0b58c665ff0b.png[/img]

notes.title: 1.69.0 - Love Shipment
notes.content:
1.69.0 - Love Shipment

Andrea finally got the... well, an idea of how society works! Society has requirements for marriage, however - a ceremony must be held. This is why we have for you a [b]NEW EVENT: Love Shipment[/b]! With it, a [b]SPECIAL OFFER[/b]: a [b]UNIQUE, LEGENDARY Azure Long Dress[/b]! Two more pictures frm Alexander Souto await unlocking, new clothes with them!

- NEW EVENT: Who knew ships are wobbly?
- SPECIAL OFFER: UNIQUE, LEGENDARY Azure Long Dress!
- NEW PICTURES from Alexander Souto!
- New clothes to unlock!

Sometimes the ceremony is much more important for others than it is for you, but perhaps it's the reason for the ceremony that is more important than the ceremony itself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33831998/2aa309cc7ae08f8c5f09ae6de8b7c6818c716550.png[/img]

notes.title: 1.68.0 - Human Condition
notes.content:
1.68.0 - [b]Human Condition[/b]

The Miracle of Life happened - Valentina bore a healthy boy! But, what does it mean to be human, anyway? To answer that question, we have for you a [b]NEW EVENT: Human Condition[/b]! In it, we have a [b]SPECIAL OFFER[/b] for you: a [b]UNIQUE, LEGENDARY Plaid Shirt[/b]! Two new pictures for you to unlock, drawn by Alexander Souto, as well as new clothes!

- NEW EVENT: What makes us special?
- SPECIAL OFFER: UNIQUE, LEGENDARY Plaid Shirt!
- NEW PICTURES drawn by Alexander Souto!
- New clothes to unlock!

Andrea struggled with this question for a while, so perhaps it's time for you to help her understand?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33831998/7c3b4659f59ef545503e63ba51622827f2624236.png[/img]

notes.title: 1.64.0 - Learn By Doing
notes.content:
Eva defeated her final fears of life, thanks to you and your support! This was an important life lesson going forward, one which Klara has had many of already. But, the learning never stops, so to show how her life changed, we have a [b]NEW EVENT[/b] for you: [b]Learn By Doing[/b]! As always, there is a [b]SPECIAL OFFER[/b] for you: a [b]UNIQUE, LEGENDARY Goth Dress[/b]! Two new pictures by Alexander Souto also await unlocking, as well as some new clothes to collect!

- [b]NEW EVENT[/b]: School's in session!
- [b]SPECIAL OFFER: UNIQUE, LEGENDARY Goth Dress![/b]
- [b]NEW PICTURES[/b]: Valentina and Yasu!
- New clothes to unlock!

Life is full of lessons, and they just keep coming - luckily, Klara faces them head-on! Come, let us support our amazon warrior!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33831998/2b5386488a84b55ad25935079290d04cb8a6b0d0.png[/img]

notes.title: 1.47.0 - Seasonal Sensations
notes.content:
Christmas is here! It is a time for togetherness, warmth and inner peace - something Sakaki craves and Eva needs! This is why you will spend the whole Christmas + New Years period with them both! For this event, we have DOUBLE the tasks, DOUBLE the rewards, DOUBLE the time! Unlock TWO SEXSCENES starring Sakaki and Eva, a whole lot of clothes, and TWO EXCLUSIVE, LEGENDARY PIECES OF CLOTHING in their own time-limited SPECIAL OFFERS:
1. EXCLUSIVE, LEGENDARY Christmas Nightgown
2. EXCLUSIVE, LEGENDARY Dancing Dress
What is more, we also have NEW KITCHEN FURNITURE for you! Complete your festive set by unlocking it with gacha! 
- NEW EVENT, double the length: Seasonal Sensations!
- NEW SEXSCENES: Sakaki and Eva figure out ways to spend time together with each other... and you.
- SPECIAL OFFER 1: EXCLUSIVE, LEGENDARY Christmas Nightgown
- SPECIAL OFFER 2: EXCLUSIVE, LEGENDARY Dancing Dress
- NEW FURNITURE: Festive kitchen set!
- Lots of clothes to unlock!
We wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year, and remember - 2019 will end only once!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33831998/f6cc08050e0e3ac157a0ecf4dba8ecfdccb20465.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 1.45.0 - Joy of Painting
notes.content:
1.45.0 - Joy of Painting

What better way of getting to know each other than to delve in creative pursuits? Fae wishes to meet someone who is creative and original - and that description definitely fits Leilani! Join us, as they will compare creative notes and how they treat their canvas in our NEW EVENT: Joy of Painting! As always, we have for you a NEW SEXSCENE, starring Fae and Leilani, a SPECIAL OFFER: An EXCLUSIVE, LEGENDARY Fishnet Skirt! Spend time as their inspiration, and new, creative clothes will be unlocked!

- NEW EVENT: Joy of Painting! Fae stands Leilani before a real canvas!
- NEW SEXSCENE: Art is supposed to bring emotion, after all!
- SPECIAL OFFER: An EXCLUSIVE, LEGENDARY Fishnet Skirt!
- New clothes to unlock!

Your girls are growing fond of each other! You wouldn't want to miss something like that, would you? Especially since their creative juices shall be flowing...!

notes.title: 1.43.0 - Broadening Horizons
notes.content:
Fae has been in an art slump recently - painting the house just doesn't cut it anymore! She needs something more magical, more mystical, more... experimental. When she paints a pentagram on your attic floor, things get out of hand quickly! To tide you over through these scary October happenings, we have a NEW EVENT for you: Broadening Horizons! This means we will have a story for you with a scary encounter, starring Fae, and a SPECIAL OFFER: A UNIQUE, LEGENDARY Wavy Ballet Dress! As always, a set of new clothes to unlock awaits for you!

- NEW STORY EVENT: Broadening Horizons! Fae summons a demon!
- SPECIAL OFFER: A UNIQUE, LEGENDARY Wavy Ballet Dress!
- Lots of new clothes to unlock!

The forces of Hell stir in your attic, ready to pounce on an unaware Fae! Protect her! She will reward you handsomely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33831998/c14c300ebd385e4bb94ee69f45c487854c343844.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 1.42.0 - Octoberfest!
notes.content:
It's time to don your lederhosen, grab a hearty, blonde bavarian girl with one hand and a mug of beer with the other, and party like it's 1869! To celebrate, we have a SPECIAL OFFER for you: continuing our belted collection, we have an EXCLUSIVE, LEGENDARY Belted Skirt!

- SPECIAL OFFER: An EXCLUSIVE, LEGENDARY Belted Skirt!

Can you hear the yodeling echo through the highlands? It's the spirit of Octoberfest, announcing its presence! Don't let it pass by without a good beer!

Valentina has been considering unorthodox methods of healing for a longer while. Her sights are now focused on Leilani with your suggestion. Could she be able to help her? Perhaps... We have for you a NEW SEXSCENE, starring Valentina and Leilani, a SPECIAL OFFER: an EXCLUSIVE, LEGENDARY Jewelled Suit, and a whole lot of new clothes to unlock!
